verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser's own open-source HyperAgent framework extends Playwright with AI, as do the page.ai and page.extract APIs. That implies the agent can drive a Playwright browser, but nothing in the pack explicitly documents running it against a local browser without a Hyperbrowser account. The core platform is otherwise described as managed cloud sessions. Missing for 10: explicit docs of a local-browser mode, confirmation that no API key or cloud account is required, and hands-on corroboration of local development use.
